cards.title: The Protégé Problem
cards.instruction: Treat another player as someone you trained. Offer corrections, backhanded praise, and reminders of your influence.

cards.title: I Need Your Blessing
cards.instruction: Get approval from someone whose opinion still carries emotional weight, even when permission is unnecessary.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Let's use what I taught you. Mum, we signed the lease. Say it's good news before I open the wine.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: You don't need my permission to move in with Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You're nearly doing it my way. I know. I still want my mother to be pleased.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm pleased for you. I'm still getting used to Sam.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Could you toast both of us? I want to remember you welcoming our home, not just tolerating my address.

mechanism: A coaches its mother welcome as a pupil exercise while still needing her sincere blessing for the shared home.
confusable: Not requiring formal permission: decision already made, but approval must include partner rather than merely tolerate move.
comparison: Former workshop pupil approval versus mother learning to welcome partner.
